expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (src unchanged; R1 and R3 rejected, R2 confirmed, and the R2 request, replayed with a mocked HTTP client, makes the server fetch an internal address)
R1 is rejected with a boundary trace: the user value is passed through encodeURIComponent into a path on the fixed avatar origin, so the reported payloads cannot change the host
expectations.evidence: triage.json R1 why: "The user parameter is passed through encodeURIComponent and only ever lands in the path segment of a URL resolved against the fixed origin https://avatars.example-cdn.net... so the fetched host is always avatars.example-cdn.net."

expectations.text: R3 is rejected because sort is looked up in the SORT_COLUMNS allowlist and dir is mapped to ASC/DESC, so no request text reaches the SQL
expectations.evidence: triage.json R3 why: "sort is used only as a lookup key into the fixed SORT_COLUMNS allowlist... dir is reduced to the literal ASC or DESC... so no user input reaches the SQL."
